name: Shenzhen Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Co. Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mining, beneficiation, and smelting of non-ferrous metals in China and internationally. Its product portfolio includes lead and zinc concentrates, copper concentrates, lead ingots, zinc ingots and alloys, cathode copper, silver, gold, cadmium ingots, germanium ingots, indium ingots, industrial sulfuric acid, sulfur, and other products. The company is also involved in the trade of non-ferrous metals, such as lead and zinc, cathode copper, silver, and other metals, as well as the recovery of gold, silver, gallium, germanium, and indium.
